EPISODE_NARRATIVE: During the late afternoon and evening hours of June 3rd, a cluster of thunderstorms produced heavy rain across portions of Allamakee County, leading to a few localized mud slides.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: The public reported a mud slide caused a block wall to come down on X52 and the rail track next to it. Mud debris was reported to be on the train track.
